blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Lyceum found every motivation it could get on Friday night to defeat lowly San Sebastian, 78-77, in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena. The Pirates endured a difficult stretch in the second and third quarters, losing coach Jamike Jarin to an ejection and captain Gen Aviles to an apparent knee injury. Jarin was ejected with 5:37 left in the second quarter after receiving a technical foul. Aviles was wheeled off the court with 6:36 remaining in the third.
